usability_paragraph: This box is a 2×H200 workhorse with 288 GB of aggregate VRAM (143 GB per GPU), NVLink active at ~478 GB/s aggregate per GPU, 460 GB of system RAM, and 36 Xeon threads. On the compute side that is very generous headroom for the speech-model work: Whisper-large-v3 fine-tunes on one card with room to spare; LLaMA-3 8B fits comfortably; a 70B model can run inference under tensor parallelism across both cards if we accept 8-bit quantisation. On the storage side we have 5.6 TB free at /mnt/volume_dkgjrkx writing at ~560 MB/s locally — that is roughly 1,800 hours of raw 16-kHz mono PCM audio, or ~28,000 hours as 32 kbps opus, or several hundred model checkpoints in the tens-of-GB range. The root disk (59 GB free) is fine for the CUDA/PyTorch stack and a working checkpoint staging area. Internet from the VM is clean (pypi and huggingface both under half a second) so we can pull models and datasets straight to the box. The one real ceiling is the pod↔VM link — a symmetric ~4.7 MB/s means shipping bulk audio into the box from this pod is not realistic; anything large should land on the box from its own internet or be uploaded directly by the owner, and we should keep pod↔VM traffic to metadata and control messages. Software base is Python 3.12 only — torch + pip need installing before any training run, but the CUDA 12.8 driver is present so this is a one-line pip step when we get there.
